project_type: Fullstack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, TypeScript Cloudflare Workers edge proxy, React/Vite frontend
build_system: pnpm workspace for edge+frontend; pip for backend; Node >=22 required
build_command: Backend: pip install -r requirements.txt (no build step); Edge: npx tsc --noEmit; Frontend: vite build
test_command: Backend: cd apps/backend && pytest tests/; Edge: cd apps/edge && npx vitest run; Frontend: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Install Python deps and run pytest for backend. 2. Install pnpm deps and run tsc --noEmit for edge. 3. Run vitest for edge tests. 4. Run vite build for frontend. 5. Run vitest for frontend tests.
setup_instructions: 1. pyenv shell 3.11 && pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt -r apps/backend/requirements-dev.in; 2. corepack enable && pnpm install; 3. Each app has its own test runner
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access for package installs. No live MongoDB/Redis/Vertex AI - tests must mock external services. No Cloudflare account access - edge tests run via vitest mocks.
contribution_requirements: pnpm-workspace.yaml defines apps/* as workspace packages. Root package.json specifies pnpm@10.26.1 and node>=22.
key_patterns: Edge worker proxies all /api/ routes to backend. JWT verified at edge, user ID injected as X-User-ID. Backend uses Beanie ODM for MongoDB. Frontend uses axios with API_BASE from VITE_BACKEND_URL env var. Auth flow: frontend -> edge (JWT verify) -> backend (edge-trust or JWT decode). CORS validated at both edge and backend.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm workspace. apps/backend: Python FastAPI (app/ has api/v1 routers, core/, models/, services/, db/). apps/edge: Cloudflare Worker (src/ has index.ts entry, middleware/, routes/, utils/). apps/frontend: React SPA (src/ has components/, pages/, context/, utils/, hooks/, lib/).
